root_causes.description: The shipping service exhibits a severe internal latency spike (server-span p99 ~5.7s, peaking at ~9.65s) while its downstream dependency quote responds normally (~2ms) and its error rate, CPU, memory, and restart counts remain healthy. The elevated latency propagates upstream to checkout (~7.3s) and frontend (~4.9s), indicating the fault originates within shipping itself rather than in a downstream dependency, error condition, or resource/pod issue.

evidence.expected_baseline: shipping p99 in low single-digit ms (healthy peers quote=1.98ms, payment=2.74ms)
quote p99 ~2ms — rules out dependency_failure originating downstream of shipping
error_rate < 0.01 — low errors rule out http_abort
no CPU saturation — rules out cpu_stress
no memory growth — rules out memory_stress
elevated consistent with upstream propagation from shipping

root_causes.description: Checkout p99 latency is elevated (~7.3s), but this is a downstream-propagation symptom: checkout calls shipping, whose internal latency spike dominates checkout request duration. Checkout itself is not the origin.

evidence.expected_baseline: baseline low latency; elevation tracks shipping latency window

root_causes.description: Frontend p99 latency (~4.9s) is elevated as an edge symptom of the checkout/shipping latency, affecting the user-facing request path; not the root cause.

evidence.expected_baseline: baseline low latency; elevated due to upstream propagation

remediation_steps: Inspect the shipping service's internal processing path (e.g., injected latency/delay or slow quote aggregation logic) during the incident window 08:09–08:16 UTC.
Check shipping deployment/config for a latency injection or resource throttle (e.g., flagd feature flag 'shipping-high_latency') and disable/revert it.
Verify shipping pod health and thread-pool/goroutine scheduling; shipping pod is otherwise healthy (no restarts, low CPU/memory), so focus on application-level latency.
Confirm recovery by re-querying shipping server-span p99 latency returning to low single-digit ms and validating downstream checkout/frontend latency normalizes.
Add latency SLO alerting on shipping p99 (e.g., >500ms) to catch internal latency regressions earlier.
